comments.body:
Thanks for looking into this.

The missing `{style}` placeholder is intentional: the style section and the `style: {style}` line were removed from the evaluation prompt on purpose in #4479, when the feedback prompt was rewritten and tuned. Adding the style back would change that prompt, and that is a product decision rather than a bug fix.

What is left over is the unused `'{style}'` entry in the `strtr` map, and we will remove it in a separate change. Closing this one.
